verdict.rationale: Letta's docs describe "dreaming": background subagents review recent conversations, consolidate useful lessons, and update memory without interrupting active work, with configurable triggers (after N steps, on context compaction, or never). The agent also decides where lessons belong when committing to MemFS, and /doctor audits duplication, supporting the autonomous-curation framing alongside the team's 'learned context over time' description. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how salient facts are selected and extracted from raw conversation, and independent or hands-on corroboration that background consolidation works well in practice.
